data.long_description:
Taormina Village 1 is the first phase of the premium collection of luxury Taormina Village residences from Reportage Properties, located in Dubiland, Dubai.

Taormina Village 1 includes 530 units, including townhouses with 3-4 bedrooms and villas with 4-5 bedrooms, built according to the highest international standards, each residence has a private balcony. The design is inspired by Italian aesthetics, and the materials used in the decoration are of the highest quality.

Residents of the complex are provided with a wide range of amenities, including several gyms, including outdoor ones, a swimming pool, a SPA salon, a yoga studio and a large landscaped park with recreation areas, barbecue areas, walking and running tracks and designated places for animals. 24-hour security with video surveillance is available on site. Kindergartens, schools, cafes, restaurants, shops and medical facilities are located within walking distance from the complex.

The project is located along the Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, allowing residents to quickly reach key points in Dubai. IMG Worlds of Adventure amusement Park is just 5 minutes away, Global Village and Zayed University can be reached in 11 minutes, and Dubai Hills Mall is 17 minutes away, Dubai Mall is 20 minutes away, and Mall of Emirates is 23 minutes away.
